quotes.speaker: Mikal Bridges
quotes.summary_phrase: Mikal Bridges on the importance of lifting to prevent injury
quotes.excerpt: Nobody wants to be injured. Nobody wants to be hurt. It just helps prevent anything.
quotes.quote: Nobody wants to be injured. Nobody wants to be hurt. And it's not that if you lift that you never get hurt, but it just helps prevent anything.

quotes.speaker: Mikal Bridges
quotes.summary_phrase: Mikal Bridges on the mental toughness required for deep playoff runs
quotes.excerpt: To be the best, you have to lose some of your summertime. Give and take, that's what you get.
quotes.quote: I love to play till June every single year and have the shortest off-season every single time. To be the best, you have to lose some of your summertime. Give and take, that's what you get.

quotes.speaker: Mikal Bridges
quotes.summary_phrase: Mikal Bridges on maintaining belief during playoff deficits
quotes.excerpt: It's just having that faith of being here before, being in these situations as we've different.
quotes.quote: It's just having that faith of being here before, being in these situations as we've different being in finals than any other playoff series, but it's still another game. It's still the same game, 48 minutes. So just having that same belief and knowing that it's going to take just one possession at a time.

quotes.speaker: Mikal Bridges
quotes.summary_phrase: Mikal Bridges on the importance of vocal communication during timeouts
quotes.excerpt: At halftime, we have the time to sit down. It's quiet, you're outside the arena.
quotes.quote: At halftime, we have the time to sit down. It's quiet, you're outside the arena, you're not just sitting at a bench and you can hear the crowd going crazy. It's your own separate time. Then throughout the game, throughout the timeouts, everybody on the bench, everybody that's playing, everybody just voicing it while we're all sitting down, chipping away a little bit. I think Jose Alvarado was a real vocal guy that was off the bench.

quotes.speaker: Mikal Bridges
quotes.summary_phrase: Mikal Bridges credits John Shackleton for his durability
quotes.excerpt: I had a strength coach, John Shackleton, who was amazing and it's kind of my first time.
quotes.quote: I had a strength coach, John Shackleton, who was amazing and it's kind of my first time, because in high school you're not really lifting that much. That was my first time understanding lifting and all the things. And I was the only guy that redshirted that year. So you have your group lifts, but then we're in season, these guys, they'll lift maybe like 45 minutes or whatever, it's nothing super crazy because they got a game, but I don't play. So now I'm in the middle of the process.

quotes.speaker: Mikal Bridges
quotes.summary_phrase: Mikal Bridges on the importance of deadlifts in his training
quotes.excerpt: I feel like I always deadlift to this day. It's always like a main exercise.
quotes.quote: I feel like I always deadlift to this day. It's always like a main exercise throughout every program I have. It's always a main. As much as I hate it, like the single leg split stance, like that Bulgarian split squat, as much, that's how I know it's good for you because how much you don't like it. If it hurts and it's painful, then it's probably a good thing. It's doing something right.

quotes.speaker: Mikal Bridges
quotes.summary_phrase: Mikal Bridges on the mental health benefits of lifting
quotes.excerpt: It shows you that your brain, mentally, if you just go do it, you can give actually way more.
quotes.quote: It shows you that your brain, mentally, if you just go do it, you can give actually way more than you think. You think you have nothing left, but then you go put it in his lift, then mentally it's just like, it's a, it's like next day you're like, hey, I dropped 20 last night and I bench pressed.

quotes.speaker: Mikal Bridges
quotes.summary_phrase: Mikal Bridges on his nutritional habits in college
quotes.excerpt: We had our grilled chicken, rice, veggies, that was like stamped all the time.
quotes.quote: We had our grilled chicken, rice, veggies, that was like stamped all the time. And there were just spots where like, I ask Shack like, oh is this okay to eat? Can I eat here? And like five guys, for example, like, is that okay? This and that. And he's just like, well the burger's grass-fed this and that. So like, you know, like guys maybe that are on the verge of like losing weight, maybe not, but like somebody like you, like you can eat that.

quotes.speaker: Mikal Bridges
quotes.summary_phrase: Mikal Bridges on his current weekly training routine
quotes.excerpt: I love to do like lower, upper, day off in between, maybe do like some yoga on that Wednesday.
quotes.quote: I love to do like lower, upper, day off in between, maybe do like some yoga on that Wednesday, then Thursday, Friday lower, upper again. So I could just go all lower, all upper, in between, then all lower, all upper again.

quotes.speaker: Mikal Bridges
quotes.summary_phrase: Mikal Bridges on his teammates' training habits
quotes.excerpt: I see him and see like his strength guy like posting whatever that like a house or something.
quotes.quote: I see him and see like his strength guy like posting whatever that like a house or something. You can see all the things they do. I think Spencer Dinwiddie, I was a teammate with him and like he was always in those doing videos like that, just all like the balancing and all that stuff and just it's just like it's just something you love to do.

quotes.speaker: Mikal Bridges
quotes.summary_phrase: Mikal Bridges on the importance of listening to your body
quotes.excerpt: I think keep doing what you're doing, but also I think at a point just like understanding your body.
quotes.quote: I think keep doing what you're doing, but also I think at a point just like understanding your body and listening to your body. I think that's like two things where like as much as you want to do something, just listen to your body sometimes.
